notes: The pytest cache plugin was disabled because preexisting local cache/temp ACLs were unreadable.
Tests ran on CPU and did not inspect or use the local GPU.
Warnings were preexisting deprecation/prototype warnings and did not fail the suite.
The suite was rerun after replacing one Python-3.9-only runtime type alias for remote Python compatibility.
A regression test verifies that the graph wrapper resolves inherited Stage S3 YAML, merges the default inference contract, and then applies audit overrides.
A regression test verifies that graph scoring selects the post-processed graph rather than the raw graphs_junc output.
The reducer distinguishes untagged training-log rows from frozen_validation rows and records evaluation SHA separately during dry-run validation.
AUPRC has a documented 1e-6 tie-policy tolerance while precision, recall, F1 and IoU retain a 1e-12 tolerance.
Graph audit tests verify Python, NumPy and Torch RNG reset plus exact repeated postprocessed-graph checksum and metric comparison.
Anchor tests distinguish latest-checkpoint all-zero later steps from the J1-best exception and scope the no-false-positive observation to latest checkpoints.
